form.label: Host Metrics — Ubuntu & Splunk servers
form.description: CPU, memory, disk and load from the Universal Forwarders.

html.h2: Host metrics via the Universal Forwarder
html.p: New to Splunk? A small agent (the Universal Forwarder) on each machine samples the OS every 60 seconds — CPU, memory, disk, load — and ships one line to Splunk. Each location has its own index, so RBAC still holds: Leo sees London, Ben sees Berlin, Gary sees everything.

ul.li: loc1 = the Splunk server itself (collects its own metrics locally — always on).

html.p: Each sample is a key=value event; the numbers (cpu_pct, mem_used_pct, …) are extracted automatically and charted with timechart.

search.query: index=loc1_metrics OR index=london_metrics OR index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics | stats dc(host) as hosts

index=loc1_metrics OR index=london_metrics OR index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics | stats latest(cpu_pct) as "CPU %" latest(mem_used_pct) as "Mem %" latest(disk_used_pct) as "Disk %" latest(load1) as "Load (1m)" latest(mem_used_mb) as "Mem MB" latest(disk_free_gb) as "Free GB" latest(site) as Site by host | rename host as Host | table Host Site "CPU %" "Mem %" "Disk %" "Load (1m)" "Mem MB" "Free GB" | sort Site Host
index=loc1_metrics OR index=london_metrics OR index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_pct) as "CPU %" by host
index=loc1_metrics OR index=london_metrics OR index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics | timechart span=1m avg(mem_used_pct) as "Mem %" by host
index=loc1_metrics OR index=london_metrics OR index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics | timechart span=1m avg(disk_used_pct) as "Disk %" by host
index=loc1_metrics OR index=london_metrics OR index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics | timechart span=1m avg(load1) as "Load (1m)" by host

panel.title: No data yet? — how this works & how to check

html.p: loc1 (the Splunk host) should appear within ~1–2 minutes with no setup — it collects locally. london/berlin appear after you install the Universal Forwarder on that Ubuntu box:
html.pre:
# on ubuntu-london curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/js-csco/splunk-dcloud/main/ubuntu/install-uf.sh | sudo bash -s -- london
# on ubuntu-berlin (also polls the local Proxmox API) curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/js-csco/splunk-dcloud/main/ubuntu/install-uf.sh | sudo bash -s -- berlin
html.p: These are event indexes, so you can look at the raw samples directly to confirm arrival: index=loc1_metrics OR index=london_metrics OR index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics | stats count by host. If loc1 is missing too, re-run apply.sh on the Splunk box.
